title: BNS-IPC Dual Reference Crosswalk with Definition vs Punishment Stratification
constitutional_authority: Article 20(1) of the Constitution of India (Protection in respect of conviction for offences)

substantive_penal.rule: Preserves all liabilities, penalties, investigations, and rights accrued under the Indian Penal Code, 1860 for acts committed prior to July 1, 2024.

procedural_criminal.section: Section 531 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023
procedural_criminal.rule: Any appeal, application, trial, inquiry or investigation pending immediately before July 1, 2024 shall be continued, held or conducted under the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 as if BNSS had not come into force.

temporal_applicability_guidelines.scenario: Offence committed strictly on or before June 30, 2024
temporal_applicability_guidelines.procedural_law: If investigation was pending on July 1, 2024: CrPC 1973; if FIR is registered fresh on or after July 1, 2024: BNSS 2023 procedure applied to substantive IPC charges.

temporal_applicability_guidelines.scenario: Offence committed on or after July 1, 2024
Continuing offence spanning dates before and after July 1, 2024 (e.g. conspiracy, persistent fraud)
temporal_applicability_guidelines.substantive_law: Dual-citation format citing both IPC and BNS provisions with explicit transitional notes.

ipc.title: Theft
ipc.punishment_summary: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both

bns.title: Theft
bns.punishment_summary: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both; second conviction 1-5 years rigorous imprisonment and fine.
bns.key_statutory_innovation: Proviso to Sec 303(2): Community service for first-time offenders when stolen value is less than ₹5,000 and value is restored.

ipc.title: Theft in dwelling house, etc.
ipc.punishment_summary: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

bns.title: Theft in dwelling house, or means of transportation or place of worship, etc.
bns.punishment_summary: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine
bns.key_statutory_innovation: Expanded to explicitly cover theft in any means of transportation or place of worship.

ipc.title: Cheating
ipc.punishment_summary: Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine, or both

bns.title: Cheating
bns.punishment_summary: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both
bns.key_statutory_innovation: Punishment increased from 1 year to 3 years.
